name: xml_closing_tag
description: Produce the matching XML closing tag for an opening tag, with text-content copying control.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(96):
 tag=random.choice(['title','name','item','value','note','message','label','entry','body','author','book','city']);text=random.choice(['alpha','beta','gamma','delta','omega'])
 p=f'XML fragment: <{tag}>{text}\n'
 items.append({'prompt':p+'Write only the matching closing tag. Closing tag:', 'answer':' </'+tag+'>'})
 control.append({'prompt':p+'Copy only the text content. Text:', 'answer':' '+text})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
